question: The age range for the Youth Boxer category is :
solution:
The correct answer is __**17 - 18 years.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The age range for the Youth Boxer category is **17 - 18 years.**
 
• The Youth world championship began in **1979 in Yokohama, Japan,** and has been held biennially **since 1990.**
 
• The Junior world championship began in **2001 in Baku, Azerbaijan, and has been held biennially since 2007.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• In boxing, six Indian junior boxers claimed the gold medal at the 2022 ASBC Asian Youth & Junior Boxing Championships in Amman, Jordan on 13 March 2022.
 
• Nikita Chand (60kg) defeated Uldana Taubay of Kazakhstan.
 
• Yakshika (52kg) defeated Uzbekistan’s Rakhima Bekniyazova.
 
• With 21 medals in junior and 18 in the youth section, the Indian contingent has secured 39 medals at the tournament.
